title: Resolution on environmental review for year-round roadway cafes
summary: This resolution adopts the Council's environmental review findings for a related bill (Proposed Int. No. 655-A) that would let roadway cafes operate year-round. It concludes that a Negative Declaration remains appropriate, meaning the proposed changes to the Dining Out NYC program would not cause significant adverse environmental impacts. The finding relies on an Environmental Assessment Statement and Technical Memorandum 003.
